title: Plane Motion Proof
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly show that the motion of the particle lies in a plane by demonstrating that the angular momentum is conserved.

title: Position Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct position functions for x and y as a function of time, incorporating the initial conditions.

title: Ellipse Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify that the motion describes an ellipse and provide the standard equation of the ellipse.

title: Period Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the period of the motion based on the derived equations.

title: Kepler's Laws Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must analyze whether the motion obeys Kepler's laws and provide a clear explanation of the result.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect application of initial conditions or miscalculating the period.
